messages:
liz_sales: Quick sync — Nexa Health wants a sandbox that reads ~5k redacted clinical notes from their S3 staging. Demo in 3 weeks. Need alignment on success criteria, access pattern, and any security blockers.

mohit_se: Do they want pull (AssumeRole) or push (presigned urls)? Preferred format? Also need token length distribution.

liz_sales: They prefer pull via AssumeRole. JSONL with patient_id (pseudonymized), note_text, note_type, date. Note lengths ~200-1,200 tokens. I'll get a sample today.

ella_cs: Draft success criteria: ingest+redaction pass on 5k notes; connectivity validated via assume-role; eval suite (entity extraction, summarization, RAG QA) with clear pass thresholds; perf target: p95 <=250ms for 512-token slices; security checklist completed (SSE-KMS, VPC endpoint).

raj_security: Need vendor questionnaire filled, network diagram (S3 -> VPC endpoint -> sandbox), KMS key ARN or wrap key details, and confirmation of retention window for sandbox snapshots. Customer-managed HSM adds 2-3 weeks.

samuel_infra: Sandbox plan: isolated VPC, egress controls, short-lived role (1 week) with s3:GetObject on prefix, validation lambda to confirm redaction metadata. Prefer AssumeRole ARN for retries. Example policy snippet we'll ask them to attach provided offline.

deploy-bot: sandbox-provisioner: job 7891 started (sandbox-nexa-213).

mohit_se: Quick eval plan: A) entity extraction (micro-F1 >= .85), B) summarization (ROUGE-L delta <= .12 + <5% hallucination by spot-check), C) RAG QA (accuracy + hallucination <5%).

liz_sales: Pricing: Nexa wants a capped pilot. Rough token estimate: avg 600 tokens/note *5k = 3M per pass; with 3 eval families + ingest ~12M tokens. Propose SOW: 3-week pilot, up to 15M tokens included, fixed fee + discounted overage.

ella_cs: I'll draft SOW and loop legal.

samuel_infra: Provisioning completed. Role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/nexa-redwood-pilot (rotate after pilot).

liz_sales: Thanks — I'll confirm with Nexa and share sample. Closing unless blockers arise.
